title: Chapter 5935: Saber Saint Of The Liu

Chapter 5935: Saber Saint Of The Liu

Chapter 5935: Saber Saint Of The Liu

“Am I a descendant of a sinner?” Chu Zhu smiled.

Everyone exchanged glances after hearing this since she seemed to be provoking the feared inspector team.

Crimson Tiger snorted and ignored her. He glanced at the boss and the workers: “Time’s running out.”

Spectators shuddered after hearing this. The inspector might not know who was the actual descendant but since no one admitted the charge, he planned to kill everyone. It was better to kill one hundred innocent victims than spare one villain - the style of Immortal Suppression Dynasty.

If a kingdom or a sect didn’t hand over the targets or if no one stepped forward, they would eliminate everyone. Debates and justification were unnecessary, hence their notorious reputation.

Some had tried to resist before but the outcome was the same each time - death.

“Sir, we-we’re just vagabonds, n-not sinners, please reconsider.” The boss begged for forgiveness.

Crimson Tiger ignored the plea and coldly uttered: “Very well, all of them then.”

Having said that, he made a killing gesture - staying true to the ruthless ways of the dynasty.

Other inspectors raised their blades to carry out the execution.

“Whoosh!” An arc as thin as a cicada's wings flashed in the air, causing heads to fall and blood to gush.

However, the ones being killed were not the boss and the workers but rather, the inspectors. These weak men somehow turned into tigers and dragons, revealing their bloodthirst. Their sabers looked uniquely thin and exuded a chilling air as they attacked the inspectors.

This development caught everyone by surprise. These men cowered and begged for mercy just a second ago and now, they seemed unstoppable.

“Fools!” The inspectors unsheathed their weapons and launched an assault.

“Kill them all!” The boss of the stand looked like a hungry tiger, seemingly wanting to slay all the inspectors.

He and his allies’ saber energy engulfed the enemies.

“Ahh!” It didn’t take long before more inspectors’ heads fell to the ground.

“Who are they?” Someone asked since this looked like a battle between tigers and a flock of sheep. Their killing style was neat and quick, each swing decapitated a target. Such a fierce method was beyond what ordinary cultivators could do.

“Enough!” Crimson Tiger himself roared furiously, releasing his vitality.

A fiery tiger manifested into reality like a volcano erupting. Its energy sent the noodle stand and the workers flying with considerable injuries.

“Break!” The boss gathered power for a swing. Waves of increasingly powerful saber intent formed an ocean, wanting to dismember the tiger.

“A bit familiar.” Li Qiye smiled after seeing the saber intent.

“Divine Tiger’s Roar!” Crimson Tiger roared and formed a mudra.

“Raa!” The giant tiger roared and released enough power to devastate the minor market, injuring the crowd.

The boss couldn’t stop the roar and his saber exploded to pieces. The blast sent him backward.

“You can die now!” Crimson Tiger gave chase and delivered a palm seal as large as a mountain.

Everyone thought the boss was going to be obliterated by the strike.

Clank!” A slash came out of nowhere and left a long trail in the night, summoning a moon.

Spectators looked up at the sky and saw the original moon still there. Crimson Tiger sensed danger and activated his tiger armor.

“Bam!” The saber intent still paralyzed him while the blade cut through his chest plate, leaving a gaping wound.

Once people calmed down, they could see the assailant was none other than the girl assigned to boiling noodles.

They saw her face clearly - beautiful with eyes resembling bright crescent moons. She had thin lips and when she pursed them, a hint of saber flash could be seen. Her expression was cold and resolute, able to accept and deal with any situation decisively.

Her tall and slender figure appeared powerful and robust with curves in all the right places.

“Who is she?” Spectators were amazed that she could wound Crimson Tiger with one move.

He was the youngest inspector in Immortal Suppression - a testament to his ability.

“Meet your maker.” She raised her saber again for another silent and swift lunar slash. The light of the moon seeped into the ground like mercury, not missing a single spot.

‘Fuck, this is it.’ Crimson Tiger was horrified and thought this was it for him.

“Bam!” A bronze hand appeared out of the void and stopped the blade from killing him.

“The Liu are amazing indeed, still surviving after all these years. Long time no see, Demon Moon Saber Saint.” Someone spoke, causing the girl’s eyes to turn colder.
